timing: perf_counter_ns; every invocation includes compile and all portfolio plans; imports, instance generation and independent validation are excluded
order: cyclically rotate policy order by instance seed and measurement round
units: planner wall time in ms; recovery in uncalibrated ticks; do not add them
selection: critical-path, weighted-critical and fixed three-plan portfolio defined before inspecting holdout; no holdout tuning
portfolio_constraint: makespan no greater than shared-successor baseline; select least loss then makespan; baseline is always eligible
scope: synthetic reserved-path constant-deficit DAG scheduling; scale means number of flow groups, not WAN nodes
